# Synthesized fixture — NOT a live capture.
#
# Dynamo cannot run in CI (it needs GPUs, etcd, NATS, and model weights, and this repo has no GPU
# runner), so metric names, types, labels, and histogram bucket ladders here are transcribed from
# the upstream source rather than scraped from a running frontend:
#
#   ai-dynamo/dynamo @ fb7169ed65d9586c16a13c837564df568e61a25e (v1.4.2)
#     lib/llm/src/http/service/metrics.rs          — metric types, labels, bucket ladders
#     lib/runtime/src/metrics/prometheus_names.rs  — metric name and label name constants
#
# Bucket ladders: the explicit arrays (tokenizer_latency_ms, images/videos/audio_per_request,
# image_tokens_per_request) are copied verbatim from metrics.rs. input_sequence_tokens and
# output_sequence_tokens are generated upstream by generate_log_buckets, so they are reproduced
# here from its documented defaults (50..128000 over 12 buckets, and 50..32000 over 10).
#
# Sample values are synthetic. Replace this file with a real trimmed scrape when a Dynamo
# deployment is available; that is strictly better than this and should be preferred.
